failure_message: ReadTimeoutError: HTTPSConnectionPool(host='api.paymentsvc.internal', port=443): Read timed out. (read timeout=5)
root_cause: Payment service sandbox occasionally takes 6-9s under load; test timeout was hardcoded to 5s.
resolution: Increased client read timeout to 15s for sandbox environment and added retry-with-backoff wrapper.

failure_message: StaleElementReferenceException: stale element reference: element is not attached to the page document
root_cause: Page re-rendered cart total after async price recalculation; element handle captured before re-render.
resolution: Switched to re-locating element inside explicit wait condition instead of caching WebElement reference.

root_cause: Default page size was changed from 25 to 20 in orders-service config during a performance tuning change; test had hardcoded expectation.
resolution: Updated test to read expected page size from service config/contract instead of hardcoding, and added a contract test.

failure_message: MemoryError: Unable to allocate 2.1 GiB for an array
root_cause: Load test dataset grew from 50k to 500k rows after data generator update; export job loaded entire dataset into memory instead of streaming.
resolution: Refactored export to stream in 10k-row chunks; added a load test threshold assertion on peak memory.

failure_message: psycopg2.OperationalError: could not connect to server: Connection timed out
root_cause: DB connection pool exhausted because a prior test in the same suite failed to close its connection, leaking a connection per run.
resolution: Added context-manager based connection handling and a teardown fixture that asserts pool size returns to baseline.

failure_message: HTTP 429 Too Many Requests from api.smsvendor.com
root_cause: Third-party SMS vendor sandbox enforces 10 req/sec; parallel test execution (pytest-xdist, 8 workers) exceeded the limit.
resolution: Added a shared token-bucket rate limiter fixture scoped to the test session for vendor-sandbox calls.

failure_message: TimeoutException: Message: Timed out waiting for element to become visible: #mfa-code-input
root_cause: MFA email delivery in staging is asynchronous and occasionally delayed 10-20s beyond the test's 8s wait.
resolution: Replaced fixed wait with polling against test mailbox API with a 30s timeout and early-exit on receipt.

root_cause: New promo-code discount type was added but discount-stacking logic did not account for percentage-then-flat ordering, introduced in commit 7c1a9f2.
resolution: Fixed discount application order in pricing/engine.py and added regression test for stacked discount combinations.

failure_message: FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: '/tmp/wkhtmltopdf/output.pdf'
root_cause: CI runner image was updated and no longer had wkhtmltopdf preinstalled; dependency was assumed present rather than declared.
resolution: Added wkhtmltopdf install step to CI pipeline and pinned version in Dockerfile.

failure_message: AssertionError: expected top result id=SKU-4471, got id=SKU-2210
root_cause: Search index was rebuilt with an updated relevance-scoring model weight change that was not communicated to QA; ranking behavior changed intentionally.
resolution: Confirmed with search team the change was intentional; updated golden-result fixtures and added a changelog-linked test data versioning process.

root_cause: Mock webhook receiver server in test harness crashed under concurrent load due to unhandled exception on malformed payload from a new test case.
resolution: Hardened mock server error handling and isolated malformed-payload test into its own process.

root_cause: Floating point rounding drift introduced when currency conversion switched from Decimal to float in a refactor (commit 9df02aa).
resolution: Reverted conversion math to Decimal with explicit rounding mode (ROUND_HALF_UP) and added property-based tests for rounding edge cases.
